NavList.note: Five rows in a sidebar-background container: icon well, label, 30px row height, rounded-lg. The active 'Home' row carries the bg-selected chip and reads clearly stronger than the resting rows.

WithStatus.note: status slot exercised with counts (12, 3) and a relative time ('Yesterday'), right-aligned in sidebar-muted ink. The long branch label truncates against the status without pushing it off the row.

WithShortcut.note: shortcutLabel + shortcutRevealVisible so the ShortcutBadge is visible at rest (⌘K / ⌘N / ⌘,) — without the reveal flag this slot is opacity-0 until group hover and would have photographed blank.

States.note: The state axis in one column: active chip, resting, disabled (dimmed, muted ink), icon-less row (label still aligns to the icon well), and a long branch name truncating with an ellipsis.
